body:
Adds `research/robofab-motorcurve`, the speed-dependent torque limit next step of `robofab-torquebound`. The nine torque- and jaw-bound rows are re-solved with a linear motor torque-speed line (no-load speed 4 to 20 rad/s). The time-optimal carry stays faster than the tuned trapezoid in all 45 cells, but its edge ranges 3.5% to 28.6% (9.0% to 22.9% under a constant limit). Stylised and preliminary. Includes the README bullet, site entry, 8 new tests and the run line.
